snippet.title: Nekome: Nazi Hunter - "The Hunt Begins" Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Nekome: Nazi Hunter now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4200110/Nekome_Nazi_Hunter/%20?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=nekome_act1&utm_term=nekome_act1_gdc&utm_content=nekome_act1_gdc_trailer-1

Nekome: Nazi Hunter is a single-player, third-person action combat game where you step into the role of Vano Nastasu, a young Romani man consumed by grief after the brutal murder of his family by Nazi soldiers. 

Turning from hunted to hunter, Vano stalks his enemies across war-torn Europe in a calculated mix of stealth, strategy, and close-quarters brutality. 

Scout patrols. 
Set traps. 
Strike with intent. 

With shared enemy awareness, fear and notoriety systems, and grounded, visceral combat inspired by grindhouse cinema, every encounter carries weight - and every kill comes at a cost. 

Learn more: https://www.nekome-game.com/

Be among the first to learn more. Join our Discord for exclusive updates, behind-the-scenes content, and future conversations with the Devs: https://discord.gg/playnekome
